name: wf-author-caps
description: wf authoring toolkit: the author-caps capability, teaching how to author capabilities, skills, and packs for the wf marketplace. Ships two model-invoked reference skills — /wf-author-caps:authoring-guide (interface-first skill design, plugin anatomy, slot and contribution semantics, the registration flow) and /wf-author-caps:authoring-taxonomy (the contribution taxonomy, manifest schema v2, phase and kind semantics) — that load by description auto-selection when an authoring question comes up, with no slash command required. Ships four scaffolders that emit real, already-linted files rather than templates — /wf-author-caps:new-skill, /wf-author-caps:new-capability, /wf-author-caps:new-pack (a complete registerable pack skeleton: plugin manifest, capability folder, and an init skill on the pack-onboarding spine) and /wf-author-caps:new-provider (a capability bound to one contract surface, speaking only the abstract operations with every binding value in a profile slot) — plus /wf-author-caps:init for one-command self-registration of the capability.
